summary: Max Verstappen won the Spanish Grand Prix from pole position, 24.1s ahead of Lewis Hamilton, with George Russell completing the podium.
George Russell made the biggest climb, from P12 to P3.
Lando Norris had a day to forget, dropping from P3 to P17.
The stewards penalised TSU (5 second time penalty).
There were 43 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 53 points over Sergio Perez.
